findings.fix: Add `mem_euclideanSection_ofMinkowski_iff : ofMinkowski v ∈ euclideanSection d ↔ v (Sum.inl 0) = 0` and derive the spacelike result from it; the spacelike statement is then the metric fact `v (Sum.inl 0) = 0 → v ≠ 0 → causalCharacter v = .spaceLike`, which needs no complexification.
findings.issue: `causalCharacter_eq_spaceLike_of_ofMinkowski_mem_euclideanSection` is under-general: `mem_euclideanSection_iff` already gives the hypothesis-free `ofMinkowski v ∈ euclideanSection d ↔ v (Sum.inl 0) = 0` (the spatial conjunct is vacuous for real `v`), so the real points of the Euclidean section are exactly the equal-time slice, not merely spacelike vectors. Exporting only the one-way `v ≠ 0 → spaceLike` consequence invites the converse misreading and withholds the equality Layer 0.4 needs.

findings.issue: `ofMinkowski_notMem_euclideanSection_of_lightLike` assumes `causalCharacter v = .lightLike`, but the proof uses only `causalCharacter v ≠ .spaceLike`; nonzero time-like vectors have no Euclidean preimage by the identical argument.

summary: Statements are general in `d` and the special cases correctly derive from `complexMinkowskiProduct_continuation`.
